capabilities: Launch detected local agent CLIs from note menus, ribbon icon, or command palette
Fill prompt templates for optimizing content, fixing layout, correcting typos, or summarizing
Send the note's absolute path and instructions as the agent's initial terminal message
Detect installed CLIs and configure executable paths and extra arguments per agent
Add custom agents that accept a prompt argument
disambiguation: Not an AI agent or chat plugin itself; it only launches externally installed agent CLIs and never edits note content directly.
extras: Not yet listed in the Obsidian community plugin directory; manual install from GitHub Releases. Desktop only (minimum Obsidian 1.5.0). README is in Chinese. Writes a short-lived prompt script to the system temp directory that self-deletes; may leave the file on abnormal exit. No telemetry, ads, or API keys in the plugin itself; MIT licensed. macOS/Linux launch paths still await real-platform validation per the README.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to hand the note you are editing to a local AI agent CLI as an initial prompt in its own terminal.
